sequenceDiagram
    participant S as Shopper or app
    participant LB as Load balancer and router
    participant APP as Shared app server
    participant POD as Pod holding this shop
    participant RL as Rate limiter for this app and shop
    S->>LB: Request for shop kestrelandpine
    LB->>LB: Look up shop in the routing table
    LB->>APP: Request with pod header
    APP->>RL: Does this app still have budget on this shop
    RL-->>APP: Yes, cost deducted, or no, throttled
    APP->>POD: Read and write only this pod
    POD-->>APP: Rows for this shop only
    APP-->>S: Response, or throttled with retry advice
